blocks.text: Privacy aur security settings users ko yeh control dene mein madad karti hain ke un ki zaati maloomat online kaise use aur share ho. Yeh settings zyada tar apps, websites aur digital platforms mein hoti hain. Talaba seekhte hain ke location, contacts aur browsing history jaisa zaati data bachane ke liye inhein kaise set karein. Privacy sambhalne se ghair-zaroori logon ya advertisers (ishtihar dene walon) ke hathon maloomat ka ghalat istemal rukta hai. Yeh settings samajh kar use karne se online sargarmiyan zyada private aur mehfooz rehti hain. Misal: Instagram par user apna account private kar sakta hai ta ke sirf approved followers us ki posts dekh sakein. Woh apni privacy ke liye location sharing band kar sakta hai aur account ki izafi hifazat ke liye two-factor authentication on kar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Instagram par apni privacy bachane ke liye kitab kaun si teen settings batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Account private karna (sirf approved followers posts dekhein), location sharing band karna, aur extra security ke liye two-factor authentication on karna.

items: Privacy aur security settings: zaati data (location, contacts, browsing history) kaise use aur share ho, is par control.
Advertisers ya ghair-zaroori logon ke hathon ghalat istemal se bachao.
